summary: Current raw OPFS composite AbortSignal remains packaged head; linked rev0187 turns OPFS posture into a returned receipt with internal byte-ledger/last-mutation fields and keeps runtime-core/package budgets under guard.
substantiveChanges: Added browserrt.browser-storage-posture-receipt.v1 in src/browser-storage-posture.mjs: quota estimate, internal byte ledger, persistence status/request, Web Locks/Buckets availability, last mutation receipt, admission status, and explicit quota/eviction/privacy non-claim proof flags.
Changed postured OPFS factories in src/browserrt.mjs to return postureReceipt and emit receipt/ledger trace fields instead of hiding posture evidence inside diagnostic prose.

Extended src/types.d.ts with RtBrowserStoragePostureReceipt plus a deduplicated RtBrowserStoragePostureConfig surface so caller-supplied internalByteLedger and lastMutationReceipt are typed once and reused.
Hardened tools/browser_storage_posture_probe.mjs and tools/browser_storage_posture_contract_audit.mjs to prove both estimate-only and supplied-ledger receipt paths.
Refactored/minified the posture module and type config to keep runtime-core closure and npm src-byte budgets under guard while adding receipt substance.
Compacted superseded linked datacube audit payloads into identity/status/summary tombstones, saving 60088 bytes and restoring the artifact budget without deleting referenced old receipt paths.
nonClaims: No runtime promotion, semver change, package publication, production readiness, cross-browser guarantee, browser quota reservation, eviction survival, fsync/power-loss durability, OPFS side-channel mitigation, Storage Buckets support, Service Worker lifetime guarantee, Web Lock fairness guarantee, automatic repair claim, or root-entry slimming claim.
The new receipt is a local posture/admission evidence shape; it does not make OPFS durable, persistent, private, globally fair, or quota-reserved.
